insights.headline: Midea Australia: off-site influence needs attention
insights.verdict: Midea Australia scores 9/100 on off-site influence (needs work). Scan tailored for local service brands — skipped g2, capterra, trustpilot as not relevant. Below 50, AI answers may rarely cite you as an off-site authority; follow the getting-started steps below.

strengths.title: Profiles found
strengths.detail: Verified on Quora, Web search, Whirlpool, ProductReview.com.au, OzBargain.

gaps.title: Review-site dimension is low
gaps.detail: Local service brands rarely appear on software review sites — focus on Google Business Profile, regional trade directories, and manufacturer dealer listings.
gaps.suggestedAction: Complete Google Business Profile, list on trade/industry directories, and link manufacturer authorisation pages from your site footer.

gaps.title: Community presence needs work
gaps.detail: Few high-engagement Reddit or Quora signals were detected.
gaps.suggestedAction: Participate in relevant subreddits and answer category questions on Quora with expert, factual posts.

gaps.title: Media & references are thin
gaps.detail: Limited news and authoritative off-site references for AI to cite.
gaps.suggestedAction: Pursue earned media, ensure Wikipedia/notability where applicable, and get listed in industry publications.

community.narrative: Limited community signals — Reddit and Q&A sites are where many AI answers source brand context.
bullets: Only 0 of 10 target Reddit threads found after widened search — try more keywords or run again later.

media.narrative: Thin media footprint — pursue press, industry coverage, and encyclopedic references.

recommendations.text: Raise off-site influence above 50/100 — prioritize press coverage and reference sites so AI models treat you as a cited authority.
Link an official subreddit or community page from your website — limited Reddit visibility reduces how often AI cites community discussion.
Pursue earned media and industry press — news domains strongly influence whether LLMs cite you as an authority.
Add sameAs schema.org links on your site footer pointing to Reddit, Trustpilot, LinkedIn, and other verified profiles.
Answer relevant Quora questions in your category — expert answers help AI associate your brand with the topic.
